originalTitle: Artificial - Official Trailer - In Select Theaters Christmas Day, Everywhere January 8
content: From Luca Guadagnino comes the story of OpenAI and a two decade artificial intelligence arms race. When a computer scientist and AI pioneer Professor Geoffrey Hinton makes a breakthrough they are certain will alter humanity forever, Sam Altman, Elon Musk and the most prominent figures in Silicon Valley race to become part of their vision. As the technology becomes more powerful and more valuable than anyone ever imagined, a battle wages over who should control the tech that could change the fate of humanity. Directed by Luca Guadagnino Starring Andrew Garfield Yura Borisov Monica Barbaro Cooper Hoffman Jason Schwartzman Ike Barinholtz Mark Rylance
